author: neal_illustrator
title: Hiring artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Kami mencari yang serius, konsisten, dan bisa kerja bareng tim. Kirim CV & Portofolio ke: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subjek: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Dibuka sampai semua posisi terisi.

author: johnnymurrayproduction
title: Looking for visual co-author / illustrator for musical podcast
content: WE HAVE THE STORIES. YOU BRING THE IMAGES. Johnny Murray Production is now looking for a VISUAL CO-AUTHOR. We are looking for an artist who can help transform sound into images — Animation Directors, Visual Storytellers, Experimental Filmmakers, Animators, Illustrators, Motion Designers, VFX Artists, Multidisciplinary Visual Artists. First visual pilot: 60. MUNDUS IMAGINALIS. Interested? Send your portfolio / showreel or simply tell us what you see when you hear Mundus Imaginalis.

author: attenboroughac
title: Open call: floral mural painter for exhibition
content: Open Call: Painting a mural for an exhibition at Attenborough Arts Centre. Jemisha Maadhavji is looking for artist/s to paint a floral wallpaper mural on one 10m wall. Open to all including students and recent graduates. Looking for a painter confident following floral pattern references, comfortable using acrylic paints. Commission fee £750. Materials provided. Duration 3 days: 28–30 September 2026. Location Attenborough Arts Centre, Leicester. Send short bio, portfolio to jemishamaadhavji7@gmail.com and Cc mybc1@leicester.ac.uk by 21st September 2026.
